$comment: Declared disposition for every file in netlify/functions/.
ci/verify-endpoints.js cross-checks this against reality: a function
marked `wired` that no live bundle can call FAILS the build. That is the
point of the file -- a status board nobody checks is a wish list.
wired    a live page calls it. Must be provable, or the build fails.
planned  real functionality, not yet reachable. Tracked, with the reason.
delete   should not exist. Its presence is reported every build.
notafunc config or an ad-hoc script that should never have been in here.
operational  reachable by a monitor or an alias, not by a page bundle. Checked differently from `wired`.

wired.leads: /admin/leads-intake -- manual staff entry (phone/walk-in) through the same public intake function the website forms target. It takes no staff token by design: gating it would break every public form that posts to it.
wired.sales-auth-check: the session probe every authenticated admin module calls
wired.sales-customers: /admin/customers -- customerRelationship.js. The function scopes every query to the rep named by the token, so the page sends no rep id and cannot see another rep's book.
wired.sales-logout: /admin/sign-in and every admin page's session teardown
wired.sales-metrics: Created for the sales team metrics panel. Returns zeros -- there is no metrics data anywhere yet. Replaces a 404.
wired.schedule-test-drive: /test-drive/ and the booking form on the vehicle detail page.
wired.search: /admin/search -- a STAFF console, not public search: search.js requires search_read and indexes CRM rows.
wired.available-dates: Created for the refactored scheduling calendar. Returns an empty availableDates array -- nothing is booked because there is no booking system yet. Replaces a 404 that read as a site fault on every page load.
wired.available-times: Created for the refactored scheduling calendar. Returns an empty timeSlots array for the same reason as available-dates.
wired.contact-salesperson: Created for the sales team directory. Returns the one real sales specialist. Replaces a 404 on the about page's team cards.
wired.pre-approval: Created for the financing calculator's pre-approval modal. Validates required fields and returns an honest 'received, not processed' response because there is no lender integration yet.
wired.send-notification: components/notification.js is imported by main.js and utils/error-event-system.js. It provides toast notifications for form submissions, errors, and success states across the site.
wired.lead-management: Wired. An agent recorded a decision to delete this in favour of `leads` and died before acting on it. The decision was wrong: site/assets/js/forms.js:135 still POSTs every form submission to /.netlify/functions/lead-management. Deleting it would have broken every form on the site. The function is the single submission endpoint for contact, lead, and inquiry forms.
wired.vehicle-features: Favourites toggle for the home page fleet, backed by a Netlify Blobs store. Chosen over front matter because a Function cannot edit the repository, and because the sync rewrites the featured field wholesale so a favourite written there would be clobbered on the next run. Degrades to the front-matter flag when the store is unconfigured.
wired.calendar-invite: Builds a downloadable .ics for a booked test drive. An .ics rather than the Google Calendar API on purpose: it needs no OAuth client, no verified consent screen and no database to hold a refresh token, so it works on the deploy that exists today, and Google Calendar, Apple, Outlook and Fastmail all read it. The two-way OAuth sync is a later step.
wired.booking-queue: Durable record of test-drive requests, on Netlify Blobs. Added because a booking was emailed and then written to Postgres: with no database configured the email arrived and the request was gone. One key per request so a write cannot clobber a concurrent one. Also what the admin calendar reads from.
wired.google-calendar: Connects Ed Google Calendar (OAuth, calendar.events scope only) and pushes booking requests onto it. Tokens live in Blobs, not an env var, so consent withdrawal can delete them. Fully wired and reports its own absence: it needs GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, which only the owner can create.
